office_does: The prosecuting attorney prosecutes crimes on behalf of the state and county, defends the county in lawsuits and is legal adviser to county officials and school directors.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Chief Civil Deputy Erik Pedersen (Prefers Democratic Party) is the only candidate for the seat held by Rich Weyrich, who is not on the ballot.

candidates.summary: 32-year deputy in the Skagit County Prosecuting Attorney's Office, most recently chief civil deputy; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Deputy prosecutor since 1994, appellate and senior deputy 1999-2021, chief civil deputy 2022-2026 [S1]
Says the office holds offenders responsible, especially violent ones, with "compassionate accountability" for drug use and mental illness [S1]
Said recall petitions against county officials cost over $100,000 in staff time [S3]
